svg.text: One linear layer to the chunk
One answer per input: with several good chunks it averages their modes.
5 noisy actions at noise time τ
The backbone never attends to the action tokens. Acting: start from
noise at τ = 1, take 10 Euler steps to τ = 0, reusing the keys and values:
Around the object on the left, or the right
